inputs.prompt: Seamless tileable texture. Orthographic photograph, taken straight on, of a clear anodised brushed aluminium shopfront panel, 1000 mm across, weathered by years of a city street: a dulled brushed finish, fine hairline scratches across the brush direction, scattered fingerprint smudges, a thin film of road dust, faint pale corrosion blooms. Flat even overcast light with no shadows, no highlights and no vignetting. The whole frame is the surface: no windows, no doors, no signs, no text, no people, no sky, no horizon.

reasons.components.base: Z-Image, Apache-2.0 at a pinned revision, whose VAE is byte-identical to FLUX.1-schnell's Apache release (licence matrix section 12)
reasons.components.control: the Z-Image Fun union control 2.1, Apache-2.0, the full version rather than the deliberately weaker lite one
reasons.conditioning.depth: the set's own height map: the recipe's exact brush lines and hairlines, a 1 mm height range. Depth is the only role this target has. MEASURED 2026-09-18 while staging: its edge picture is every pixel black, because a 1 mm brush field has no step a crease or plane test can find, and staging now refuses to stage a conditioning picture of one flat value. Session 1's rule said edge fails on a cell field; this material does not even reach the point of failing, and that is a cheaper answer than 16 generations; encoding: the recipe's exact height map as grey, raised relief white, which is the near-is-white convention depth controls were trained on
reasons.container: the image this lane built from its committed recipe, pinned by digest
reasons.guardrails: these models ship no guardrail, and their only inputs are a committed texture set's own relief and a prompt written from the catalog, with no people and nothing personal
reasons.inputs: the recipe's own words for what it painted, weathered, with every feature stated without a position in the world, because a tile that implies where it sits cannot repeat
reasons.sampler.guidance_milli: 4.0, the guidance VideoX-Fun's Z-Image control example uses
reasons.sampler.name: the flow-match Euler scheduler the base repository ships and VideoX-Fun's own example selects
reasons.sampler.negative_prompt: a single space, which is what enables true classifier-free guidance in this pipeline without describing anything
reasons.sampler.steps: 25, the step count VideoX-Fun's Z-Image control example uses
reasons.sampler.tiling: the lane's tiling schedule: the latent grid and the control latents are rolled by a seeded offset each step and rolled back, because a transformer model has no convolution padding to make periodic
reasons.sampler.width: 1024, the published sets' own width, so the output needs no resampling to become a set
reasons.sampler.wrap_margin_px: 64 px, eight latent pixels of the neighbouring tile given to the VAE on each side and cropped after, so its convolutions see the tile's other edge instead of zeros
reasons.seed: seed index 1 of 4 by the job's seed rule: the first four bytes, big-endian, of sha256 of 'exulanica.appearance-seed/v1:<job>:<target>:<candidate>:<role>:<index>'

regeneration: GPU generation is not bit-exact across hardware, drivers or library versions. These output bytes are the artifact. Running this record again makes a new version with new digests; it is never a replay.
